sheet_name: ขยาย 2, SX, S0, S1, S2, ขยายครีบ คสล. รอบอาคาร, รอยต่อเสา CN1, CN2, CX
source_image: image/บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_06/บ้าน_เล็ก_2ชั้น_06_หน้า45.png
warnings: The last structural sheet in this extraction: the four slab types used on the plans (S0, S1, S2, SX) plus four small details — 'ขยาย 2' (the carport slab edge referenced from S-04/หน้า31), the perimeter RC fin, and the CN1/CN2 and CX column-to-beam joints.

S1 and S2 are drawn as sections across their SHORT span ('ด้านสั้น'), 1.50m and 2.20m respectively — those are the slab's short dimension, not a member length, so they are recorded as span_short_m and not as width/depth. Both are 0.10m thick with a top and a bottom mat; the '#' suffix on every bar call means bars each way.

These sections show S1/S2 as in-situ two-way slabs, but the floor plans mark every room bay with an 'SP' precast solid-plank direction arrow (S-01 notes item 4). The two are not contradictory on the face of it — the plank system plus a topping would still be detailed as a slab section — but which bays are precast plank and which are the in-situ slab detailed here is not resolved by any sheet in this extraction. Flagged rather than assumed.

SX is a cantilever/eave slab: 0.90m projection, 0.10m thick, Ø9@0.20 each way top and bottom, with a 0.25m downstand at the free edge. It is the slab tagged 'SX' over the east room on the ring-beam plan (S-06/หน้า33).

S0 is the ground-bearing slab: 0.10m thick on 0.10m ทรายหยาบบดอัดแน่น, a single Ø9@0.25 mat each way, with the joint against the RC beam sealed — 'รอยต่ออุดด้วยแอสฟัลท์ หนา 1 ซม.' (asphalt-filled joint 1cm thick). Recorded because it is a real construction requirement, not just a drafting note.

The two 'รอยต่อเสา' details show how CN1/CN2 and CX stop against the beam above; they carry only a 0.30 (and 0.30/0.30 for CX) dimension and no rebar of their own, so they are recorded as joint details with the dimension in the note rather than invented as members.
Bar-type convention: ø9มม recorded as 'RB' (plain round). Every bar on this sheet is Ø9.
